Turn 1

La Capitán

HP: 75

In play: La Paradoja Magnifica: 15

[hr]
Start of villain turn: No hero ongoing or equipment to destroy. Villain trash and deck is shuffled.

Play a card: Temporal Thief. Take top card of each hero deck: Inspiring Presence, Savage Mana, Fling into Darkness, The Masadah, and Know When to Hold Fast.
La Capitan deals each hero target 1 psychic damage (Legacy 31, Haka 33, Idealist 10, Medico 12, Mainstay 13, Writhe 13, Chrono-Ranger 27, Scholar 28).

End of villain turn: La Capitan deals 4 projectile damage to Haka (29).
La Paradoja Magnifica: play “Walk the Plank!”. La Capitan deals 3 psychic damage to Legacy (28). Legacy cannot use powers until start of the villain turn.

posts.name: Oaktree
posts.cooked:
Haka - HP: 30

Play: Elbow Smash the boat for 4 [11]

Power: Crush the boat for 3 [8]

Draw: Haka of Restoration

==

Figure that smashing the boat was more valuable than a few points on LC that she will heal up shortly.  And if we're lucky we might take the boat down before the flip, and it'll stay in the trash for a while.

Do we have a preference about a strategy regarding LC herself, and which side of her card we prefer to deal with?
